title: Closing-Year Tax Letter of an Ended Entrance Fee Agreement
content:
**Rule.** The tax year in which an **Entrance Fee Agreement** ended receives one closing-year letter, issued with the January letter run that follows that year, and never a second letter for that year.

**Conditions of issue.**

The tax letter for the year in which an agreement terminated is issued only after the agreement's ledger carries an amortization entry for every month of occupancy that began on or before the termination date.

The tax letter for the year in which an agreement terminated is not issued until the agreement's ledger carries a tax letter for every earlier tax year in which entrance fee or independent living monthly fees were paid.

Read against the agreement's ledger, the closing-year letter waits while either of these states is missing:

| State of the agreement's ledger | Closing-year letter may be issued |
|---|---|
| An amortization entry for every month of occupancy that began on or before the termination date, and a tax letter for every earlier tax year in which entrance fee or independent living monthly fees were paid | Yes |
| A month of occupancy that began on or before the termination date carries no amortization entry | No |
| An earlier tax year in which those fees were paid carries no tax letter | No |

## Issuing the letter

The letter is issued with the tool `issue_closing_year_tax_letter_050bd78c`, which the agent unlocks and then calls. It enters one tax letter entry stating the medical expense amount given on the agreement's ledger, dated today and marked with the tax year in which the agreement ended; the refundable balance is not changed. The letter is sent to the mailing address on file. The tool computes nothing and checks nothing of its own.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `entrance_agreement_id` | Reference number of the ended Entrance Fee Agreement the letter is issued for, read from the entrance fee agreement lookup | Identifier |
| `tax_year` | The tax year in which the agreement ended | Four digits, YYYY |
| `medical_expense_amount` | The medical expense amount the letter states | USD, non-negative, 2 decimal places, entered rounded half up to the cent |

**Receipt.** On success: `status` ("closing_letter_issued"); `entrance_agreement_id`; `entrance_entry_id` (reference number of the tax letter entry); `tax_year` (YYYY); `medical_expense_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places); `issue_date` (YYYY-MM-DD).
